question: The graphs of the equations 2x + 3y = 4 and 3x - y + 5 = 0, intersect at P (α, β). What is the value of (3α - 4β)?
solution:
**Given:**

The graphs of the equations 2x + 3y = 4 and 3x - y + 5 = 0

**Calculation:**

[2α + 3β = 4] × 1 .........(1)

[3α - β = - 5] × 3 ..........(2)

Adding both (1) & (2)

(2α + 3β) + (9α - 3β) = - 15 + 4 

⇒ 11α = -11

⇒ α = -1 

Substituting the value of α in equation (2)

3α - β = - 5

⇒ (3 × -1) - β = - 5 

⇒ - 3 - β = - 5 

⇒ - 3 + 5 = β 

⇒ β = +2

According to the question,

⇒ (3α - 4β) = (3 × (-1) - 4 × 2) 

⇒ - 3 - 8 = - 11

**∴ The value of (3α - 4β) is - 11.**
